{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Construction |name = Tool store 2 |image = [[File:Tool store 2 built.png|200px]] |icon = [[File:Tool store 2 icon.png]] |furniturename = Tools |release = [[31 May]] [[2006]] |update = PLAYER-OWNED HOUSES! |level = 25 |experience = 120 |room = [[Workshop]] |hotspot = [[Tool space]] |flatpack = No |examine = Bucket, spade, tinderbox and knife. |id = 6787 |itemid = 8385 |leagueRegion = General }} The '''tool store 2''' can be built in the [[tool space]] of the [[workshop]] in a [[player-owned house]]. It requires 25 [[Construction]] to upgrade the [[tool store 1]] and gives 120 [[experience]] when built. The player must have a [[hammer]] and a [[saw]] in their inventory to build it. Players can withdraw unlimited amounts of [[bucket]]s, [[knife|knives]], [[spade]]s, and [[tinderbox]]es from the tool store. While the store requires its previous tier to be upgraded, it does not replace the preexisting tier as there are five separate slots for tool stores in the workshop, one for each tier. ==Creation==
